own_scenes.desc: Estilo lento, pesado y fangoso que se remonta a algunas canciones de Black Sabbath de los setenta. En los ochenta lo tocan Saint Vitus, Candlemass y Trouble; en los noventa Crowbar y los psicodélicos Sleep, y su cruce con el gótico, grupos como My Dying Bride y Avernus.

refs.q: Doom metal, a sludgy slow and heavy style that can be traced to some of Black Sabbath’s 1970s songs
refs.para: Doom metal, a sludgy slow and heavy style that can be traced to some of Black Sabbath’s 1970s songs, categorizes 1980s bands St. Vitus, Candlemass, and Trouble. It continued with bands like Crowbar and the psychedelic-tinged Sleep. A hybrid of doom and goth music describes other ’90s bands like My Dying Bride and Avernus.

works.name: No Help for the Mighty Ones

podcast.title: "Dark Equivalent of New Age"
podcast.body: In a metaphorical sense, Doom Metal is considered the "dark equivalent of New Age within Metal." Experiencing a genre album or attending a concert is likened to a collective ceremony, where the body is traversed by deep vibrations reminiscent of ancient rituals, transforming feedback, sustain, and distortion into symbolic tools of invocation. "En cierto modo, el Doom ventriase del equivalente oscuro del New Age dentro del Metal. Escucharon un disco del género, Mo'Mohora One, asistir a un concierto, al final, no dejas de ser como una ceremonia colectiva donde tu cuerpo es atravesado por vibraciones graves que recuerdan antiguos rituales."

srcs.episode: El DOOM METAL es el DARK SOULS de la música

podcast.title: Academic Perception and Reevaluation
podcast.body: Traditionally ignored or not taken seriously in academic circles due to its extreme symbologies and perceived noisiness, Doom Metal is increasingly being analyzed by scholars and theorists. They are approaching it from theological, mystical, and philosophical perspectives, recognizing its deep intellectual readings, much like minimalist and drone music have received. "El Doom Metal suele ser ignorado en el ambito académico, o al menos tomado por conserio en parte por todas estas invologías extremas y ser demasiado ruidoso. Pero cada vez más estudiosos y teóricos están empezando a analizarlo desde perspectivas teológicas, místicas y filosóficas."

srcs.episode: El DOOM METAL es el DARK SOULS de la música

podcast.title: Accidental Birth from Injury
podcast.body: Doom Metal did not originate from a happy idea but from an accident and a wound. This paradoxical origin gave rise to the heaviest and darkest sound in music, a direct result of Tony Iommi's injury and his innovative solution to continue playing guitar. "El Doom Metal funciona de la misma manera, un genero que no nació de una idea feliz, sino de un accidente, de una herida que, paradogicamente, dió luz al sonido más pesado y oscuro de la música."

srcs.episode: El DOOM METAL es el DARK SOULS de la música

podcast.title: Cathartic and Hopeful Experience
podcast.body: A study interviewing 74 fans of Doom Metal concluded that, despite its association with dark themes like depression and death, the genre can be profoundly cathartic and hopeful. For many listeners, Doom Metal does not generate sadness but provides meaning to deep emotional experiences, with some even stating it helped them through difficult times. "Preparando el vídeo he dado con un estudio en el que su autor, entrevista a 74 fans del género, y llega la conclusión de que el Doom Metal, a pesar de estar asociados con temas oscuros como la depresión y la muerte, puede ser profundamente catártico y esperanzador."

srcs.episode: El DOOM METAL es el DARK SOULS de la música

podcast.title: Connection to Eastern Philosophy and Transformation
podcast.body: The philosophy of Alan Watts, who bridged Eastern philosophy with the West by advocating that negativity or darkness is a path to understanding and personal transformation, can be directly applied to Doom Metal. The genre's darkness is seen not as something to avoid, but as a teacher that opens up deeper life experiences, leading the listener through negativity to find something affirmative. "Alan Watts, conocido por acercar la filosofía oriental a Occidente, defendía que lo que solemos percibir como negativo o oscuro, no es algo que debamos evitar, sino un camino hacia la comprensión y la transformación personal. Y esto se puede trasladar al Doom Metal."

srcs.episode: El DOOM METAL es el DARK SOULS de la música

podcast.title: Consolidation in the 1990s and 2000s
podcast.body: The genre solidified and began to attract more fans worldwide during the 1990s and 2000s. Bands during this period expanded the genre's atmosphere, adding new layers of tension, desperation, and terror to its proposals, leading to the exploration of even more extreme territories. "Durante los 90 y los 2000 el genero se consolido y empieza a tener cada vez más fans por todo el mundo."

srcs.episode: El DOOM METAL es el DARK SOULS de la música

podcast.title: Defining Musical Characteristics
podcast.body: Doom Metal is characterized by slow, heavy tempos, with riffs becoming longer and repetitive, and sustain stretching almost infinitely, multiplying the inherent heaviness of metal. These bands aimed not to dazzle with speed, but to trap the listener in an oppressive atmosphere where each beat feels like a ton. "Los riffs se volvieron más largos y repetitivos, el susto en se estiraba hasta el infinito, la pesadier del metal se multiplicó. Era como si cada compás, es ser una tonelada."

srcs.episode: El DOOM METAL es el DARK SOULS de la música

podcast.title: Emergence in the 1980s
podcast.body: While its roots trace back to Black Sabbath's early sound, Doom Metal began to truly take shape in the 1980s. This was a reaction against the prevailing trend in metal which favored faster, more technical, and virtuosic sounds, as some bands consciously chose slowness and atmosphere. "Pero en Paláleo ese éxito, empezás a surgir una reacción opuesta. Algunas bandas decidieron apartarse de esa aceleración constante y poner el peso, la lentitud y la atmósfera en el centro de la propuesta."

srcs.episode: El DOOM METAL es el DARK SOULS de la música

podcast.title: John of the Cross Analogy
podcast.body: The experience of Doom Metal can be likened to Saint John of the Cross's concept of the "dark night of the soul," where one faces absolute darkness not for destruction, but for transformation. The darkness is not a punishment but a necessary process for reaching a higher form of understanding, emphasizing walking through pain, feeling it, and finding strength in the experience. "Lo que predicaba es cuando la cruce en la noche oscura, ese momento en el que da el matrabi es una oscuridad absoluta, no para destruirse, sino para transformarse. Para él, la oscuridad no era un castigo, sino un proceso necesario para alcanzar, una forma más alta de comprensión."

srcs.episode: El DOOM METAL es el DARK SOULS de la música

podcast.title: Journey Without Destination
podcast.body: The prolonged riffs, slow tempos, and dense atmospheres of Doom Metal create a space suspended in time that invites reflection. Feeling the electric guitars resonate through the body becomes an almost primitive experience, where for a moment, all notion of progress and the frantic rhythm of daily life is lost. The genre is described as a journey without a destination, with its objective being to inhabit the sound itself. "El Doom Metal es un viaje que no tiene destino, porque es objetivo, no es llegar a ningún sitio, es evitar el sonido."

srcs.episode: El DOOM METAL es el DARK SOULS de la música

podcast.title: Paradoxical Peace and Comfort
podcast.body: Despite its dark themes of death and the void, people often find peace, clarity, and even comfort in Doom Metal. This darkness, far from destroying, transforms into something akin to light, functioning as a refuge—a space to pause and breathe, where the music opens up an avenue for deep feeling. "Pero si el Doom Metal y estos subgéneros son tan oscuros, tan lentos y tratan temas como la muerte, vuelva a cío, porque la gente encuentra en ellas paz, claridad y hasta con suelo. Que es lo que ocurre para que esa oscuridad lejos de un dierte, tiene vuelve algo parecido a la luz."

srcs.episode: El DOOM METAL es el DARK SOULS de la música

podcast.title: Profound Esoteric Symbology
podcast.body: From its inception with Black Sabbath, Doom Metal has embraced profound esoteric symbology, incorporating occultism, mysticism, mythology, and alchemy. This imagery extends beyond mere satanic provocation, serving as a visually coherent discourse with the musical content to generate a contemplative, introspective, and almost spiritual atmosphere that connects the listener with primordial emotions, the sublime, the ancestral, and the transcendent. "Desde sus inicios, el Doom Metal ha sido de simbología sotérica. Ocultismo, místicismo, mitología, alquimia, todo ello para explorar dimensiones que van más allá de la provocación satanica."

srcs.episode: El DOOM METAL es el DARK SOULS de la música

podcast.title: Ritualistic and Ancestral Connection
podcast.body: The deliberate slowness of Doom Metal imbues it with a ritualistic quality, connecting more with the ancestral than with spectacle. It represents a return to the essential and the earthly, seeking to immerse and envelop the listener through distortion and the suspension of time, differentiating itself through the depth of its atmosphere rather than superficial darkness. "Esa lentitud deliberada acercaba al metal algo ritual que conectaba más con lo ancestral que con el espectáculo, un retorno al asencial y lo terrenal que buscaba sumergir y envolver mediante la distorsión y la suspensión del tiempo."

srcs.episode: El DOOM METAL es el DARK SOULS de la música

podcast.title: Search for the Sacred in the Profane
podcast.body: Doom Metal actively reclaims and gives meaning to the esoteric within a disenchanted world, seeking the sacred in the profane and the spiritual in the marginal. Its visual and sonic symbology aims to open the experience toward the inexplicable, consciously inviting the listener to participate in a spiritual quest. "Hay una búsqueda de los agrados en lo profano, de lo espiritual en lo marginal. El Doom no se toma la ligera a lo de sotérico, sino que lo remindica para darle sentido dentro de un mundo desencantado."

srcs.episode: El DOOM METAL es el DARK SOULS de la música

podcast.title: Slow and Intense with Goth Elements
podcast.body: Doom Metal is described as a "slow and intense" genre that has absorbed elements of Goth. "Same thing with Doom Metal, which is slow and intense."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Structure as Prolonged Sonic Ritual
podcast.body: Unlike faster metal subgenres, Doom Metal is structured as a prolonged sonic ritual where time dilates, notes are suspended, and the music becomes a state of mind. The use of drone, repetition, and silences creates a trance-like effect, similar to religious chants or shamanic meditations, enveloping the listener rather than progressing. "A diferencia de otros subgéneros del Metal más acelerados, el Doom se estructura como ritual sonoro prolongado. El tiempo se dilata, las notas se suspenden y la música se convierte en un estado mental."
